meta.source: Brand guide and brand-token sheet from Arch's Duha Media chats (April 2026)

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Text, nav, dark section backgrounds. 17.85:1 on white.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Primary accent and hover states; fill for the primary CTA (white text 6.0:1). Ghost links on light grounds. Fails on ink (2.98:1): never crimson text on dark sections.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: CTAs, links, active states. White text on magenta is 4.31:1, below 4.5:1: use it as a button fill only at 18.66px bold / 24px+, otherwise fill with crimson.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Callouts and badges, sparingly. Always ink text on gold (11.24:1). Never dominant.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Subtle section tints and newsletter blocks only (ink text 14.2:1). Never dominant.

tokens.name: offwhite
tokens.usage: Page background, alternate content sections, cards.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Content sections; text on ink and on crimson.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Section ground. Light: white content section. Dark section: ink (hero, CTA band).

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating content section and card ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on bg / bg-alt.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and mono metadata. Light = ink at 60% (4.69:1 on white); dark = white at 60% (6.99:1 on ink). The older ink/40 metadata value fails (2.55:1) and is retired.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules and table dividers, 0.5–1px. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, white text. One primary CTA per page or section.

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Ghost links (mono, uppercase, underlined, arrow suffix). On dark sections gold, since crimson fails on ink.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: We engineer the foundation. Then we prove it works.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headers. Lead with the number.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy. Generous leading; let it breathe.
styles.sample: Every change, test, and outcome is documented. You see the data, the rationale, and the results.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and secondary button labels (secondary at 500).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: ALL CAPS. Labels, tier identifiers, tags, eyebrows.
styles.sample: CLASS B · CRO CORE · SETUP + RETAINER

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Dates, hex values, data callouts, in text-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base step (Tailwind 4px grid).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between mark and wordmark; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (py-2.5).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; side gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (px-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Nav horizontal padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding. Generous whitespace signals confidence.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Section bands, dividers, tier bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, tags. The maximum on primary elements: sharp corners signal precision.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The logo disc only.
